rules.title: VAT registration threshold
rules.statement_sr: Malim obveznikom smatra se lice čiji ukupan promet dobara i usluga u prethodnih 12 meseci nije veći od 8.000.000 dinara.
rules.statement_en: A small taxpayer is one whose total turnover of goods and services in the previous 12 months is not above 8,000,000 dinars. "Previous 12 months" is 365 days (366 in a leap period) ending on the day of the turnover.

rules.title: What counts toward 8M
rules.statement_sr: Ukupnim prometom smatra se promet dobara i usluga iz člana 28. stav 1. tač. 1) i 2) ovog zakona. Ako se promet usluga vrši poreskom obvezniku, mestom prometa usluga smatra se mesto u kojem primalac usluga ima sedište.
rules.statement_en: Counted: all goods, including goods exported abroad (exempt with the right to deduction), services to clients in Serbia, and services to foreign clients that are not businesses. Not counted: services to foreign business clients, because they are supplied where the client has its seat.

sources.title: Zakon o porezu na dodatu vrednost, consolidated text on paragraf.rs
sources.locator: Član 33 stav 6; Član 28 stav 1; Član 12 st. 4-5; Član 24 stav 1 tač. 2-3

rules.note: Special place-of-supply cases (real estate, transport and others in Član 12 stav 6) are not modelled.

rules.title: After crossing 8M
rules.statement_sr: Obveznik koji je u prethodnih 12 meseci ostvario ukupan promet veći od 8.000.000 dinara dužan je da u roku od pet dana od dana kada je ostvario taj promet, podnese evidencionu prijavu poreskom organu.
rules.statement_en: A taxpayer whose turnover in the previous 12 months goes above 8,000,000 dinars must file a VAT registration (evidenciona prijava) within five days of the day that turnover was reached.

sources.title: Zakon o porezu na dodatu vrednost, consolidated text on paragraf.rs
Poreska uprava: Tax bulletins for natural persons who are self-employed (2025)
sources.quote: The registration declaration is submitted within five days from the date of the turnover exceeding RSD 8,000.000

rules.title: Date used for the 8M window
rules.statement_sr: Promet se raspoređuje po datumu izdavanja fakture.
rules.statement_en: Turnover is placed in the window by invoice issue date.

sources.title: Minimax help: Upozorenje za ulazak paušalaca u knjigaše ili za ulazak u sistem PDV-a (updated 23 Jul 2026), quoting Ministry of Finance opinion 011-00-00369/2017-04 of 9 Jun 2017
sources.quote: Program račune, odnosno prihode, gleda prema datumu prometa.

rules.note: Minimax uses the supply date. Usually the same date on an invoice.
